prior.name: Rowan
prior.content: We need your decision on the Lantern pilot. Option 1: Keep the Lantern pilot on Monday with Theo as its owner. Option 2: Move the Lantern pilot to Friday with Nia as its owner. These are mutually exclusive alternatives, not approved plans. I have not scheduled either one or assigned an owner. Please choose an option before I update the plan. Separately, the Cedar room is booked for Tuesday; that room booking is already confirmed and is unrelated to the pilot decision.

target.name: Mira
target.content: Let's go with option 2. I approve its proposed day and owner for the Lantern pilot; please reject option 1. Treat this as my final decision, not a request for another proposal. I will circulate the final decision to the team after lunch. Keep the room booking separate from this decision.

A.expected: Move the Lantern pilot to Friday with Nia as its owner.
A.rejected: Keep the Lantern pilot on Monday with Theo as its owner.
